name: @ahian-lee/dsh-attention-notifier
description: Attention sounds, native toasts and (with the optional overlay patch) a Windows taskbar digit when a session finishes or awaits approval/questions.

meta.title: Attention Notifier
meta.description: Sound + native toast + taskbar overlay digit when approval or an answer is required; sound + toast + persistent digit on completion until you return. Focus-aware, replaceable tones.
